prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a parking lot collision in Katy, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1428; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for taking the time to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep it to the accident, if that's okay.
Q: That's fine, we can use a placeholder for your name. Where did the collision happen?
A: In a parking lot at a shopping center in Katy, Texas. I was pulling out of a parking space near the main entrance.
Q: What were you doing right before the impact?
A: I checked my mirror, didn't see anything, and started backing out slowly. Then I heard a loud bang and felt the car jolt.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle before contact?
A: No. It came from the lane behind the row of cars. I didn't see it until my door was already hitting it.
Q: How fast would you estimate you were moving?
A: Maybe two or three miles an hour. It was very slow.
Q: Did you hit your head or feel any injury at the time?
A: My head struck the side window. I didn't think much of it at first, but I got a headache within an hour and felt dizzy when I stood up.
Q: Have you seen a doctor since the collision?
A: Yes, I was seen the same day and was diagnosed with a concussion. I've been told to rest and avoid screens for a while.
Q: Are you experiencing any other symptoms right now?
A: Some light sensitivity and trouble concentrating. I get tired faster than usual, and reading is hard for me.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was careful and I'm not sure why the other driver was moving so fast through the lane.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Thank you.
